title: A Study to Assess Targeted Therapies for Treatment of Adults with Moderate to Severe Psoriasis
official: A Phase 2 Multicenter Platform Trial of Targeted Therapies for Treatment of Adult Subjects with Moderate to Severe Psoriasis
summary:
Main objective: - To evaluate the efficacy of monotherapy and/or combination therapy as measured by PASI score in subjects with moderate to severe PsO
- To assess the safety and tolerability of monotherapy and/or combination therapy in subjects with moderate to severe PsO
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Clinical diagnosis of chronic plaque psoriasis (PsO) with or without psoriatic arthritis for at least 6 months before the Baseline Visit
2. Stable moderate to severe chronic plaque psoriasis with or without Psoriatic arthritis (PsA) at both Screening and Baseline Visit defined as follows: ≥ 10% Body Surface Area psoriasis involvement, Static Physician's Global Assessment score of ≥ 3, and PASI score ≥ 12
3. Candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy as assessed by the investigator.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants with any form of PsO other than chronic plaque PsO (e.g., pustular PsO, palmoplantar pustulosis, acrodermatitis of Hallopeau, erythrodermic, or guttate PsO).
2. Participants with a history of current drug-induced PsO or a drug-induced exacerbation of pre-existing PsO.
3. Participants with a history of active ongoing inflammatory skin diseases other than PsO (with or without PsA) that could interfere with the assessment of PsO (e.g., hyperkeratotic eczema).
